comingLast.roast: off 31 on 17 - gallant to the end, blue to the finish
he can still pass Nicholson - stranger things have happened, rarely to him
Nicholson needs him to stay exactly this bad for 6 more holes
safe by 1 - unless Nicholson finds form, in which case, gulp
finished with a 1-point buffer - his group is still reminding him hourly
in with a 2-point moat - drawbridge stuck halfway up
2 points of daylight - barely enough to read by
with 3 to play he is 2 from the drop - points, please, any denomination
only 3 clear of the blue balls - one blow-up and they are his
